_comment: Hand-written Thai for the strings HikaShop has no word for. Merged over the ones taken from
HikaShop's own th-TH file by tools/build-locales.mjs, so regenerating keeps these.
Thai counts in one form: the noun does not change after a numeral, and the classifier does
the work instead (5 รายการ, 3 รูป, 5 คืน).
Polite ครับ/ค่ะ particles are left out, as they are in the HikaShop backend: a control label
with a particle reads as speech rather than as a button.
